content_of_post_to_comment: Building in public sounds like showing people what you're figuring out. Then you share an idea, learn something new, and realize you want to change it. Suddenly you're worried about looking inconsistent. You were documenting an experiment. Somehow it started feeling like a promise.
comment: Maybe the real promise of building in public isn't consistency of direction, but consistency of honesty. Changing your mind becomes a credibility problem only when the audience expects certainty rather than evidence.
